answer: Identity cost is amortised over behaviour rather than purchase. A key is free to create and worth nothing until it answers a fresh vault. Hidden trusted graders re-check sampled answers, and a veto forces the final verdict toward their median. An attacker cannot see which lane samples which answer, so the quartz of buying votes must cover the whole panel rather than one seat. Scaling the vertex therefore means financing independent reasoning across every account, while the cap keeps the marginal account earning less than it costs. Seal s5cqw.
